name: Hero hairline grid
purpose: Make the hero read as a measured engineering drawing rather than a poster, by exposing the grid the hero's own content is placed on.

content.note: Zero content fields. This section is pure geometry — six vertical tracks, nine horizontal tracks and two cross marks, all placed by named grid areas.

from640.areas: h-line-1..9, v-line-1..4, vs-line-1, vs-line-2, cross-1, cross-2

intentionalUpstreamBug.statement: The original's stylesheet declares grid areas `vs-line-1` and `vs-line-2`, while its DOM writes `v-line-5` and `v-line-6`. Those two names match nothing, so the two elements auto-place instead of landing in their declared tracks. The clone reproduces this verbatim, with a code comment.
intentionalUpstreamBug.verification: src/styles/hero.css:412 declares 'vs-line-1' / 'vs-line-2'; src/components/Hero.jsx:116-118 writes gridArea v-line-${n} for n=1..6. Confirmed by direct grep.
intentionalUpstreamBug.rule: A generator MUST NOT 'repair' this. It is reproduced on purpose as part of pixel fidelity.

motion.pattern: The line tracks fade/scale in on a 3s transition off --intro-delay:0.1s, as part of the hero's paint-time intro.

constraints.note: Node 0 of the template. The hero grid is declared before anything placed into it.
